mode.description: Source of the panel text: Direct or Calendar
mode.tooltip:
Direct: you type and set the text yourself.
Calendar: shows the active event from your selected calendar(s).

max-text-length.description: Truncate panel text to this length (0 = no limit)
max-text-length.tooltip: Applies to the final text, including any "Until"/"Remaining" suffixes in Calendar mode. Hovering the panel always shows the full untruncated text.

show-icon.description: Show an icon to the left of the panel text

selected-calendar.tooltip: "System Default" always tracks whatever calendar your system currently considers the default (shown in parentheses) - if that changes, this follows automatically, no need to re-pick anything. The list is fetched once each time Focal (re)loads and appears here automatically - no need to reopen or reload Settings. If listing fails, an error entry appears here instead, with System Default kept as a working fallback.

poll-interval-seconds.description: How often to re-check the calendar

show-upcoming-fallback.description: When not currently in an event, show the next upcoming one (dimmed)
show-upcoming-fallback.tooltip: Only looks ahead until the end of today - an upcoming event tomorrow or later won't show, even with this on.

default-event-color.description: Text color for events with no color of their own

override-event-color.description: Always use the color above, even for events with their own color
override-event-color.tooltip: Off (default): an event's own calendar color wins when it has one, falling back to the color above otherwise. On: always use the color above, ignoring the event's own color.

show-event-end-time.description: Show when the current event ends
show-event-end-time.tooltip: Adds "Until 5:00 PM" after the event text. Time format (12h/24h) follows your system's setting. Only applies to the current event, not the upcoming-event preview.

show-time-remaining.description: Show how much time is left in the current event
show-time-remaining.tooltip: Adds "Remaining 1h, 7m" after the event text. Only applies to the current event, not the upcoming-event preview.

upcoming-color.description: Text color for the dimmed upcoming-event fallback
